settings.html: 30% to 50% is the sweet spot

settings.title: The Right Humidity Level Changes Everything

settings.editor: Health and comfort experts agree that indoor relative humidity should sit between 30% and 50%. Drift too far in either direction and your home—and your family—feels it.
When humidity drops below 30%, your forced-air heat pulls moisture out of everything:

settings.html:
• Static shocks and frizzy, unmanageable hair
  • Dry skin, chapped lips, and bloody noses
  • Scratchy throats and worsened cold and flu symptoms
  • Gaps and cracks in hardwood floors, trim, and furniture
  • Air that feels colder than it is, so you crank the heat higher

settings.editor: When humidity climbs above 50%, moisture has nowhere to go:

settings.html:
• A sticky, clammy feeling even with the AC running
  • Musty odors, especially in basements
  • Mold and mildew growth on walls and in corners
  • Dust mites and allergens that thrive in damp air
  • An AC that runs constantly trying to keep up

settings.html: Dry winter air

settings.title: Whole-Home Humidifiers: Beat the Dry Winter Air

settings.editor: A whole-home humidifier installs directly into your furnace and adds precise moisture to the warm air moving through your ducts. You set your target level once, and it maintains it automatically all winter.

The problem isn't your thermostat. It's your home's humidity. At Lenz Heating & Cooling, we install whole-home humidifiers and dehumidifiers that connect right into your central HVAC system to hold your home in the healthy, comfortable range all year—automatically, and without a single portable unit cluttering your floor.
Why homeowners love them:

settings.html:
• Healthier air: Fewer sinus problems, less dry skin, and relief during cold and flu season
  • Protects your home: Stops hardwood floors, doors, trim, and wood furniture from cracking and shrinking
  • Feels warmer for less: Properly humidified air feels warmer, so you can lower the thermostat a couple degrees and cut your heating bill
  • Zero hassle: No tanks to refill like a portable unit—it draws water and drains automatically

settings.html: Muggy summers

settings.title: Whole-Home Dehumidifiers: Dry Out the Muggy Season

settings.editor: A whole-home dehumidifier pulls excess moisture out of your entire home—not just one room—working alongside your AC to keep summer air crisp and your basement fresh.
Why homeowners love them:

settings.html:
• Kills the mustiness: Finally makes damp basements usable and odor-free
  • Stops mold before it starts: Cuts the moisture mold and mildew need to grow
  • Feels cooler for less: Dry air feels cooler, so you can raise the thermostat and ease the load on your AC
  • Protects your home: Prevents moisture damage to walls, framing, and stored belongings
